summary: Amazon.com Inc. filed a Form 424B5 prospectus supplement for a public offering of $750M floating-rate notes due 2029 and $24.173B fixed-rate notes across seven tranches (4.600% to 6.250%) due 2029–2066, totaling ~$24.9B. The notes are senior unsecured, not listed on any exchange, and rank equally with existing debt. Proceeds to Amazon (before expenses) are estimated at $24.867B. Underwriting discounts total $56.1M. This is a routine debt capital markets transaction—an ordinary shelf takedown for general corporate purposes. There is no acquisition, divestiture, activist, or other special-situations element.
